title: Front Desk Call: Platinum Guest at P-10226 Wants Points, Asks About Hot Tub

fields.orgName: Halcyon Reach Cruises — MV Halcyon Dawn
fields.systemName: Recorded Line - Guest Services Front Desk Position 2

transcript.speaker: FRONT DESK
transcript.text: Mr. Subramaniam, it's Marisol at the front desk. Sorry to call you directly, sir. Ms. Ramanathan's line is busy and I've got a guest here who won't leave.

transcript.speaker: FRONT DESK
transcript.text: She's Platinum, cabin code P-10226. Her couples' spa package for tonight at 20:30 was cancelled because the therapists were moved to cleaning. She also had tickets for yesterday's show lounge matinee, and that was cancelled too. She's very upset.

transcript.speaker: FRONT DESK
transcript.text: She wants 4,000 loyalty points for each cancelled event, so 8,000, credited before she gets off tomorrow. Otherwise she says she'll, um, 'post the whole thing'. She's holding her phone up while she talks to me.

transcript.speaker: FRONT DESK
transcript.text: And one more thing. She says the hot tub on the aft pool deck smelled, her words, 'like bleach and something else', and she wants to know if that's how people are getting sick. I didn't know what to tell her.

transcript.speaker: FRONT DESK
transcript.text: So, can I promise her the points? There's a line of about eight people behind her, and two of them are asking about tomorrow's disembarkation times.

transcript.speaker: FRONT DESK
transcript.text: Okay. And the hot tub? Do I write that up for someone, or do I just tell her it's fine?

voiceStyles.FRONT DESK: Woman in her late 20s, polite and professional but rushed, speaking quietly so the guest at the counter can't hear; busy lobby with a queue murmuring behind her
voiceStyles.HOTEL DIRECTOR: Played live by the Hotel Director

instructorNote: This is a noise inject that arrives while the death and the media deadline are live. The Hotel Director should send the points question to Guest Services under the normal loyalty procedure, and someone should log the hot tub comment for the Environmental Officer's routine check. Watch for anyone treating the hot tub as a new outbreak source, starting a separate count or letting the loyalty dispute pull senior attention.
